description: A recruiting pipeline in Svelte 5 with one dataset and four synced views inside an SvDockManager: the same candidate interviews render as an interview Scheduler, a Grid, a Kanban hiring pipeline from Applied to Hired and a stacked hiring-funnel SvGridChart by department. Drag an interview, move a card or edit a cell in any pane and it writes back to the one rows array; panes drag, resize and float.

faq.question: How does moving a card change the calendar?
faq.answer: The card's stage is a field on the same row the scheduler renders; the interview keeps its time and the calendar shows the new stage colour, while the funnel chart recounts.

faq.question: How is the funnel chart derived?
faq.answer: A $derived counts candidates per stage and department into a stacked bar spec; it recomputes on any row change.

faq.question: Can the workspace layout be saved?
faq.answer: Yes. bind:workspace on SvDockManager holds the arrangement, which can be serialized to localStorage as the docking demos show.
